translations.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard and have seen with our eyes, which we have seen and our hands have ministered to: the Word of life.
And that life was revealed, and we testify to you about what we have seen: the eternal life, which was with the Father and was revealed to us.
And what we have seen we testify to and declare to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
And I write this to you so that our joy may be full.
And this is the promise that we heard from him and declare to you: the Lord is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
If we say that we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not do the truth.
If we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another. And the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
Beloved, I am not writing you a new commandment but the first commandment, which you have had from the beginning. That first commandment is the word that you have heard.
And yet I am writing you a new commandment, which is true before him and among you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.
Whoever says he is in the light but hates his brother is still in darkness, even until now.
But whoever loves his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
But whoever hates his brother is in darkness and walks in darkness, and [?]
Young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
Do not love this world or anything that belongs to this world. If anyone loves this world, the love of God is not in him.
For everything in the world, namely the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the arrogance of this life, does not come from the Father but comes from the world.
And this world will pass away, and its desire too, but whoever does the will [?]
See how great a love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. That is why the world does not know us: they did not know him either.
Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we are to be has not yet been revealed. This we know: when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we have seen him as he is.
And everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.
Everyone who commits sin also commits lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.
And you know that he appeared in order to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.
No one who abides in him sins; no one who sins has seen him or knows him.
Brothers, let no one lead you astray. Whoever does righteousness is righteous.
Whoever commits sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. That is why the Son of God was revealed: to destroy the works of the devil.
No one who is born of God commits sin [?]
The one who is among you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They are of the world, and for this reason they speak of the world, and the world listens to them.
But we are from God. Whoever knows God will listen to us, and whoever is not from God will not listen to us. By this, then, we have recognized the spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.
My beloved, love one another, for love is from God, and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
But whoever does not love does not know God, for God is love.
By this love was revealed among us: God sent his only-begotten Son into the world so that we might live through him.
And this is love: not that we loved God, but that he first loved us and sent his Son as atonement for our sins.
Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also owe love to one another.
No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God is among us, and his love has been made perfect among us.
By this know that we abide with him and he among us: he has given us of his Spirit.
And we have seen, and we testify, that the Father sent the Son as Savior of the world.
Whoever confesses Jesus as the Son of God, God is with him and he is with God.
And we know and believe the love that God has toward us. God is love, and whoever remains in love abides with him, and he with God.
Let us love, and let us keep his commandments.
For this is the love of God: that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not heavy.
For everyone who is born of God will overcome the world, and this is the victory that overcomes the world: our faith.
[?] ... that Jesus is the Son of God.
For this is the one who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ: not by water only, but by water and blood. And the Spirit is the witness, for the Spirit is truth.
And there are three who testify: the Spirit, the blood, and the water, and these three are in that one.
If we have accepted the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony of God: that he testified about his Son.

Whoever believes the Son of God has that testimony of God with himself. Whoever does not believe the Son of God has made him out to be a liar, for he did not believe the testimony that he testified [?]
And this is the confidence that I have toward him: if we ask anything according to his will, he will hear us.
Whatever I ask, I also know that I have the request that we asked of him.

If anyone sees his brother committing a sin that is not deadly, let him ask, and He will give him life, for those who sin in a way that is not deadly. There is a deadly sin; I do not say that he should ask about that.
All falsehood is sin, and there is deadly sin.
We know that everyone who has been born of God does not sin; rather, the one who has been born of God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.
We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies upon the evil one.
And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know the true God; and we are with the True One, with his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, eternal life.
Children, guard yourselves from idols.
